compactRecord.rs: Walk the Roman forum ruins, enter the basilica for the breathtaking floor mosaics (allow 45 min), then tour the Museo Archeologico Nazionale's amber, glass and portrait busts from the 2nd-century AD harbour city.
compactRecord.td: Roman colony founded 181 BC; one of the empire's five largest cities and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The 4th-century basilica floor contains the largest early-Christian mosaic in the Western world — over 700 m² of narrative floor art.

compactRecord.rs: Drive or take the train to Fogliano Redipuglia station; climb the 22 marble staircase terraces to the hilltop cross for views over the Isonzo plain — site of 11 WWI battles and over 650,000 deaths.
compactRecord.td: Italy's largest WWI military memorial: 100,000 Italian soldiers rest on 22 terraced marble steps on Monte Sei Busi, each grave inscribed 'Presente!' — one of the most emotionally powerful monuments in Europe, built 1938.
